tokens.name: bg-page
tokens.usage: App background behind every screen.

tokens.name: bg-surface
tokens.usage: Bottom navigation bar and sticky headers.

tokens.name: bg-card
tokens.usage: Cards: episode cards, stat tiles, season rows, search field.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of cards and rows; poster placeholder.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: 1px outline on cards, rows and the search field.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Focused or hovered outlines (3:1 on bg-card).

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Titles and body text on bg-page and bg-card.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Meta lines, synopses, labels on bg-page and bg-card (7:1).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Captions and inactive nav icons; 4.9:1 on bg-card, small text OK.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Fills: primary buttons, selected chips. For icons and bars drawn on the page use accent-mark. Points at the active accent palette (burgundy); switch palettes by repointing the accent tokens.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button and chip hover. Points at the active accent palette (burgundy); switch palettes by repointing the accent tokens.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent as text: stat values, links, 'Show more', counts, card toggles. Points at the active accent palette (burgundy); switch palettes by repointing the accent tokens.

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for selected rows and the completed season row. Points at the active accent palette (burgundy); switch palettes by repointing the accent tokens.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills (13:1 white on burgundy). Points at the active accent palette (burgundy); switch palettes by repointing the accent tokens.

tokens.name: accent-mark
tokens.usage: Accent for marks drawn straight on the page: active nav icon, progress fill, chart bars. Points at the active palette's -mark tone.

tokens.name: rating
tokens.usage: Star rating glyph only.

tokens.name: favorite
tokens.usage: Not used on cards: poster toggles, the heart included, fill in accent-text. Kept for a future favourites-only accent; leave unused unless the design changes.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Fully-watched check marks and 'Up to date' state.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions (remove from list) and errors.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Round backing behind icons that sit on poster art.

tokens.name: indigo-on
